English: Mortality and morbidity in patients with diabetes mellitus (DM) are attributed to both microvascular and macrovascular complications.
Luganda: Okufa n’okufuna endwadde mu balwadde ba sukaali (DM) kuva ku buzibu obutuuka ku busuwa obutono n’emisuwa eminene mu mubiri.
Yoruba: Ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀-ikú àti ààrùn kíkó tí ó jẹ mọ́ àwọn aláìṣà tí ó ní ìtọ̀-ṣúgà (DM) jẹ́ kíkà sí ara ṣégeṣège àwọn òpó ńláńla àti kéékèèké.
Zulu: Ukugula nokushona kweziguli eziphethwe ushukela (DM) abekwa ezinkingeni ezibandakanya ama- microvascular nama-macrovascular.
Hausa: Mace-mace da tsananin ciwo cikin masu ciwon suga na da alaqa da qanana da manyan matsaloli da suka shafi zuciya.
Northern Sotho: Mahu le go lwala ga balwetši bao ba nago le kelo ya godimo ya swikiri ka mading di amantšhwa le malwetši a go hlasela ditšhika tše nnyane le a go hlasela ditšhikakgolo ka bobedi.
Amharic: በስኳር በሽተኞች (ስ.በ) ዘንድ ያለው ታማሚነት እና ሟችነት፣ደም ቅዳ፣ ደም መልስ፣ እንዲሁም ካፒላሪስ በሚባሉት እና በሰውነት ውስጥ የተለያየ ስራ በሚያከናውኑት  የደምስሮች   ውስጥ በሚያጋጥም መወሳሰብ (ማይክሮ ቫስኪዩላር እና ማክሮ ቫስኪዩላር) ላይ ተጥሏል፡፡

English: However, there is a significant amount of variation in the primary studies on DM regarding the prevalence of erectile dysfunction (ED) in Africa.
Luganda: Wabula, waliwo ekyukakyuka ya maanyi mu kunoonyereza okw’enkizo okukoleddwa ku bulwadde bwa sukaali (DM) mu Afrika nga kwekuusa ku butaba na maanyi ga kisajja (ED).
Yoruba: Àmọ́ ṣá, iye oríṣìí ìkẹ́kọ̀ ìpìlẹ̀ nípa DM tí ó nííṣe pẹ̀lú ìwọ́pọ̀ àìlèṣe-bí-ọkùnrin (ED) ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà pọ̀ púpọ̀.
Zulu: Nokho, kunokuhluka okukhulu uma ubheka ucwaningo lashukela (DM) lokuqala olukhuluma ngokwanda kokungavukelwa (ED) e-Afrika.
Hausa: Saidai, akwai bambamci mai yawa cikin binciken da aka gudanar kan DM wajen yawaitar mutuwar azzakari a Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, go na le palo ye e bonalago kudu ya phapano go dinyakišišo tša motheo tša bolwetši bja kelo ya godimo ya swikiri ka mading mabapi le go ata ga go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna ka Afrika.
Amharic: ሆኖም ግን፣ በአፍሪካ ውስጥ በስ.በ ዘንድ ያለውን የብልት መቆም ችግር (ብ.መ.ች) መስፋፋትን  በተመለከተ፣ በመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ጥናቶች ውስጥ ጉልህ መጠን ያለው ልዩነት ታይቷል፡፡

English: Therefore, this study was aimed to estimate the pooled prevalence of ED patients with DM and its association with body mass index (BMI) and glycated hemoglobin in Africa.
Luganda: Awo nno, okunoonyereza kuno kwagenderera okukola okuteebereza okw’awamu ku bantu abatalina maanyi ga kisajja (ED) abalina obulwadde bwa sukaali n’engeri gye kwekuusa ku buzito (BMI) ne puloteyini ya sukaali mu Afrika.
Yoruba: Nítorí náà, iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí gbèrò láti ṣe ìṣirò ìwọ́pọ̀ àwọn aláìsàn ED tí ó ní DM àti àwọn àsomọ́ rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú òòrìn tòhun gíga tìbútòro (BMI) àti imogilobíìnì ajẹmọ́-ṣúgà ní Ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke, lolu cwaningo beluhlose ukulinganisa ukwanda kwe-ED okuhlangene ezigulini ze-DM nokuhlangana kwayo nobukhulu bomzimba i-(BMI) ne-glycated hemoglobin e-Afrika.
Hausa: Saboda haka, wannan binciken na nufin qiyasta yawaitar masu ED da DM da alaqarsa da nauyin jiki (BMI) da sinadarin protin mai tafiyar da numfashi a Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Ka gona, dinyakišišo tše di be di nepile go akanya go ata ga mohlakanelwa ga balwetši ba go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna bao ba nago le bolwetši bja kelo ya godimo ya swikiri ka mading ye e sepelelanago le kelo ya mmele o montši (BMI) le kelo ya klukhose ka mading ka Afrika.
Amharic: ስለዚህ፣ ይህ ጥናት ያነጣጠረው በአፍሪካ በስ.በ ውስጥ ያለው አጠቃላይ የብ.መ.ች መስፋፋት ከአጠቃላይ የሰውነት ትልቅነት ጠቋሚ (አ.ሰ.ት.ጠ) እና ከግላኬትድ ሄሞግሎቢን ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት መገመት ላይ ነበር፡፡

English: PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Scopus, PsycINFO, African Journals Online, and Google Scholar were searched for studies that looked at ED in DM patients.
Luganda: PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Scopus, PsycINFO, African Journals Online ne Google Scholar byakeberebwa okufuna okunoonyereza okwakolebwa ku butaba na maanyi ga kisajja mu balwadde ba sukaali.
Yoruba: PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Scopus, PsycINFO, African Journals Online, àti Google Scholar jẹ́ yíyẹ̀wò fún àwọn iṣẹ́ tí ó sọ nípa ED lára àwọn aláìsàn DM.
Zulu: Kuphenywe ucwaningo olubheke i-ED ezigulini ze-DM kwi-PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Scopus, PsycINFO, African Journals Online ne-Google Scholar.
Hausa: An binciko matattarar aiyuka na PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Scopus, PsycINFO, African Journals Online, and Google Scholar don tsamo binciken da aka yi kan ED ckin masu ciwon DM.
Northern Sotho: PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Scopus, PsycINFO, African Journals Online, le Google Scholar di ile tša fetlekollwa go dinyakišišo tšeo di bego di lebeletše go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna go balwetši bao ba nago le kelo ya godimo ya swikiri ka mading.

English: A funnel plot and Egger’s regression test were used to determine publication bias.
Luganda: Ekipande ekikebera ensobi n’enkola ya Egger ey’okukebera ensobi mu kunoonyereza byakozesebwa okuzuula ensobi eziri mu kunoonyereza.
Yoruba: Ète Àyẹ̀wò fọ́nẹ́ẹ̀lì àti Egger jẹ́ lílò láti mọ àìṣedéédé àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí.
Zulu: Kusetshenziswe indlela eyifanela i-funnel plot ne-Egger’s regression ukuhlola ukukhetha icala kokushicilelwe.
Hausa: An yi amfani da tsarin funel plot da tsarin baibai na Egger don son rai ke cikin ko wani bincike.
Northern Sotho: Go šomišitšwe ppoloto ya fanele le diteko tša go befela pele ga seemo tša Egger go lekola go tšea lehlakore ga kgatišo.

English: The I2 statistic was used to check heterogeneity between the studies.
Luganda: Enkola ya I2 ey’ekibalo yakozesebwa okukebera enjawulo eyeeyoleka mu kunoonyereza.
Yoruba: Ìṣirò I2 jẹ́ lílò láti wo àwọn ìyapa inú iṣẹ́ náà.
Zulu: Kusetshenziswe i-I2 statistic ukubheka i-heterogeneity  phakathi kocwaningo.
Hausa: An yi amfani da lissafin I2 don gano bambamce-bambamce da ke tsakanin aiyukan da su ka gabata.
Northern Sotho: Go šomišitšwe dipalopalo tša I2 go lekola go fapafapana magareng ga dinyakišišo.

English: DerSimonian and Laird random-effects model was applied to estimate the pooled effect size.
Luganda: Ennyinyonnyolero ya DerSimonian ne Laird yakozesebwa okuteebereza obugazi bw’ebizuuliddwa mu kunoonyereza okw’enjawulo okw’awamu.
Yoruba: Òpó ipa-aláyìípo DerSimonian àti Laird jẹ́ lílò láti ṣèṣirò ìwọ̀n ìrinlẹ̀ iṣẹ́ ìwádìí náà.
Zulu: Kusetshenziswe imodeli ye-DerSimonian ne-Laird random-effects ukukala usayizi wendawo ethintekile.
Hausa: An yi amfani da tsarin DerSimonian da taswirar gano tasiri na Laird don awna yawan tasirin faxin aiyukan.
Northern Sotho: Go dirišitšwe mmotlolo wa DerSimonian le diabe tša sewelo tša Laird go akanya bogolo bja seabe sa mohlakanelwa.
Amharic: አጠቃላይ የውጤቱን መጠን ለመገመት፣ ዴርሲሞንያን እና ሌርድ ራንደም-ኢፌክት ሞዴሎች ተግባር ላይ ውለዋል፡፡

English: The subgroup and meta-regression analyses were conducted by country, sample size, and year of publication.
Luganda: Okusengejja obubaka obw’ebibinja n’ebizuuliddwa mu biwandiiko eby’enjawulo kwakolebwa okusinziira ku ggwanga, omuwendo gw’abeetabi n’omwaka ekiwandiiko mwe kyafulumizibwa.
Yoruba: Ìtúpalẹ̀ ọ̀wọ́lọ́wọ̀ọ́ àti ìtúpalẹ̀ ajẹmọ́-mẹ́tà jẹ́ ṣíṣe pẹ̀lú orílẹ̀-èdè, ìwọn iṣẹ́, àti ọdún tí a gbé iṣẹ́ jáde.
Zulu: Ukuhlaziya kwamaqoqwana kwenziwe nge- meta-regression analyses, kwenziwe ngezwe nezwe, usayizi wenani labantu abahloliwe, nangonyaka okushicilelwe ngawo.
Hausa: An awna bayanan ta hanyar kwatanta su bisa qasa, yawan mutanen da aka yi bincike a kansu, da shekarar wallafa aiki.
Northern Sotho: Go dirilwe tshekatsheko ya sehlopha se sennyane le go befela pele ga seemo ka kakaretšo go lebeletšwe naga, bogolo bja sampole, le ngwaga wa kgatišo.
Amharic: የንዑስ ቡድን እና ሜታ-ሪግሬሽን ትንተናዎች፣ በሃገር ደረጃ ፣ በናሙና መጠን፤ እና በህትመት አመት ላይ ተካሂደዋል፡፡

English: Sensitivity analysis was deployed to see the effect of a single study on the overall estimation.
Luganda: Okwekaliriza ekireetezi kye kituusa ku kikosebwa kwakolebwa okulaba okunoonyereza okumu gye kukosaamu okuteebereza okw’awamu.
Yoruba: Ìtúpalẹ̀ aláfojúlẹ̀ṣe jẹ́ lílò láti rí ipa iṣẹ́ kan ṣoṣo lórí ìṣirò àbájáde àpapọ̀.
Zulu: Kube sekwenziwa i-sensitivity alaysis ukubona umthelela wocwaningo olulodwa kukho konke okugaguliwe.
Hausa: An yi amfa da nazarin fahimtar alaqa don gano tasirin xaya daga cikin aiyukan kan lissafin da aka samu baki xaya.
Northern Sotho: Go šomišitšwe tshekatsheko ya go kwa maikutlo go bona seabe sa dinyakišišo tšeo di dirilwego gatee go kakanyo ka bophara.
Amharic: አንድ ነጠላ ጥናት በጠቅላላው ግምት ላይ ያለውን ተጽእኖ ለማየት፣ የሴንሲቲቪቲ ትንተና ስምሪት ላይ ውሎ ነበር፡፡

English: STATA version 14 statistical software was used for the meta-analysis.
Luganda: Enviisirizo y’ebibalo eya STATA ekika 14 yakozesebwa okusengejja ebizuuliddwa mu biwandiiko eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Ẹ̀yà 14 irin-iṣẹ́ aṣèṣirò aláìrídìmú STATA jẹ́ lílò fún àtúpalẹ̀ tó gbòòrò náà.

English: We estimated that the pooled prevalence of ED in patients with DM in Africa was 71.45% (95% CI: 60.22–82.69).
Luganda: Twateebereza nti obutaba na ED okw’awamu mu balwadde ba sukaali mu Afrika kwali ku bitundu nsanvu mu kimu n’obutundutundu ana mu butaano ku buli kikumi (71.45%) (95% CI: 60.22–82.69).
Yoruba: A ṣèṣirò pẹ́ ìwọ̀n ìwọ́pọ̀ ED lára àwọn aláìsàn tí ó ní DM ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà jẹ́ 71.45% (95% CI: 60.22–82.69).
Zulu: Sigagule ukuthi ukuvama okuhlanganisiwe kwe-ED ezigulini ze-DM e-Afrika kube u-71.45% (95% CI: 60.22–82.69).
Hausa: Mun yi hasashen cewa yawaitar ED cikin masu DM a Afirka da kai mizanin kashi 71.45% (95% CI: 60.22–82.69).
Northern Sotho: Re akantše gore ditiragalo tša mohlakanelwa tša go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna go balwetši bao ba nago le kelo ya godimo ya swikiri ka mading ka Afrika e be e le 71.45% ((95% CI: 60.22–82.69).
Amharic: በአፍሪካ ውስጥ፣ በስ.በ ዘንድ ያለው የብ.መ.ች ስርጭት 71.45% እንደሆነ ገምተናል (95% CI: 60.22–82.69)፡፡

English: Diabetic patients whose BMI was ≥30 kg/m2 were 1.26 times more likely to develop ED (AOR = 1.26; 95% CI: 0.73–2.16) and whose glycated hemoglobin was <7% were 7% less likely to develop ED (AOR = 0.93; 95% CI: 0.5–5.9), although they were not significantly associated with ED.
Luganda: Abalwadde ba sukaali abaalina obuzito bwa obuwera naye nga tebusukka 30 kg/m2 oba okusingawo baalina omukisa gwa kitundu 1.26 okubulwa amaanyi g’ekisajja (AOR = 1.26; 95% CI: 0.73–2.16) ate abaalina ekipimo kya puloteyini ya sukaali (hemoglobin) eri wansi w’ebitundu 7% baalina emikisa 7% obutabulwa maanyi ga kisajja (AOR = 0.93; 95% CI: 0.5–5.9) wadde nga baali tebalina bukwatane bwa maanyi nnyo ku butaba na maanyi ga kisajja.
Yoruba: Àwọn aláìsàn ìtọ-súgà tí BMI wọ́n ≥30 kg/m2 ṣeéṣe kí wọn ó jẹ ED (AOR = 1.26; 95% CI: 0.73–2.16) yọ pẹ̀lú 1.26 ìgbà àti àwọn tí imogilobíìnì ajẹmọ́-ṣúgà wọn jẹ́ <7% were 7% ṣeéṣe kí ó má jẹ ED (AOR = 0.93; 95% CI: 0.5–5.9), bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé wọn kò ní àsopọ̀ pẹ̀lú ED lójú páálí.
Zulu: Iziguli ezinoshukela ezine-BMI engu ≥30kg/m2 zisemathubeni angu 1.26 ukuthi ziphathwe i-ED (AOR = 1.26; 95% CI: 0.73–2.16) and whose glycated hemoglobin was <7% were 7% less likely to develop ED (AOR = 0.93; 95% CI: 0.5–5.9), yize bezingabandakanywa ne-ED.
Hausa: Masu ciwon suga da suke da mizanin nauyin jiki na ≥30 kg/m2 sunfi kamuwa da ED da wajen kashi 1.26 wato (AOR = 1.26; 95% CI: 0.73–2.16) waxanda sinadari mai tafiyar da numfashi ya nuna maki <7% na da qarancin kamuwa da ED (AOR = 0.93; 95% CI: 0.5–5.9) da kashi 7%, ko da yake masu da cikakkar alaqa da ED.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši bao ba nago le twetšiswikiri bao BMI ya bona e bego e le ≥30 kg/m2 go be go na le kgonagalo ya makga a 1.26 a gore ba ka itemogela go se Tsogelwe ga Setho sa Bonna (AOR = 1.26; 95% CI: 0.73–2.16) gomme bao kelo ya bona ya klukhose ka mading e bego e le <7% go be go na le kgonagalo ya ka fase ga 7% ya gore ba ka itemogela go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna (AOR = 0.93; 95% CI: 0.5–5.9), le ge e le gore go be go sa tloge go amana kudukudu le go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna.
Amharic: ምንም እንኳ ከብልት መቆም ችግር ጋር ጉልህ ዝምድና ባይኖራቸውም ፣የስኳር በሽተኞች ጠቅላላ የሰውነት ትልቅነት (BMI) ≥30 kg/m2 የነበሩ፤1.26 ጊዜ የብልት መቆም ችግር ሊያጋጥማቸው ይችላል፤ እንዲሁም (AOR = 1.26; 95% CI: 0.73–2.16)  እና ግላይኬትድ ሄሞግሎቢናቸው <7% የሆኑ ደግሞ የብልት መቆም ችግር የማጋጠሙ እድል በ7% ያነሰ ነው ፤ (AOR = 0.93; 95% CI: 0.5–5.9)

Yoruba: Nítorí náà, ọ̀nà-àbáyọ̀ tó bàsẹ̀lẹ̀ wí àti ètè ìdèènà ajẹmọ́lù tó forísọ̀ṣẹ̀lẹ̀ gbọdọ̀ jẹ́ gbígbé kalẹ̀ láti mú àdínkù bá ìwọ́pọ̀ ED láàrin àwọn aláìsàn tí ó ní DM.

English: Millions of diabetes patients around the world suffer from erectile dysfunction, but the numbers in Africa were unknown until now.
Luganda: Obukadde bw’abantu abalwadde ba sukaali okwetooloola ensi yonna tebalina maanyi ga kisajja naye emiwendo gyabwe mu Afrika gibadde tegimanyiddwa n’okutuusa kaakano.
Yoruba: Ẹgbẹ̀gbẹ̀lẹ́gbẹ̀ àwọn aláìsàn ìtọ-súgà káàkiri àgbááyé ni ó bá àìlèṣe-bí-ọkùnrin fínra, àmọ́ ṣá, iye rẹ̀ ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà kò hàn síta di àsìkò yìí.
Zulu: Izigidigidi zeziguli eziphethwe ushukela emhlabeni wonke zihlushwa ukungavukwelwa, kodwa izibalo zase-Afrika bezingaziwa kuze kube manje.
Hausa: Miliyoyin mutane a faxin duniya masu ciwon suga na fama da mutuwar azzakari, amma ba a san adadin ba a Afirka kawo yanzu.
Northern Sotho: Dimilione tša balwetši bao ba nago le twetšiswikiri go kgabaganya lefase ba na le bothata bja go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna, eupša dipalopalo ka Afrika di be di sa tsebje go fihla gabjale.
Amharic: በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ በአለም ዙሪያ ያሉ  የስኳር በሽተኞች፣በብልት መቆም ችግር ይሰቃያሉ፤ ሆኖም ግን በአፍሪካ ውስጥ ያሉት ቁጥራቸው እስካሁን ድረስ አልታወቀም ነበር፡፡

English: Approximately 425 million people suffered from diabetes mellitus (DM) globally in 2017, and this is projected to rise to 629 million by 2045.
Luganda: Kumpi abantu obukadde 425 baalwala (DM) sukaali okwetooloola ensi yonna mu mwaka gwa 2017 ate ng’omuwendo guno guteeberezebwa okweyongera okutuuka ku bukadde 629 omwaka gwa 2045 we gunaatuukira.
Yoruba: Ó súnmọ́ mílíọ̀nù 425 àwọn ènìyàn tí ó bá àìsàn ìtọ-súgà (DM) fínra káàkiri àgbááyé lọ́dún 2017, èyí sì ń gòkè láti tó mílíọ́nù 629 lọ́dún 2045.
Zulu: Ngo-2017 abantu abalanginaselwa ezigidini ezingama-425 baphathwe ushukela (DM) emhlabeni, lezi zibalo zilindeleke ukuthi zifike ezigidini ezingama-629 ngo-2045.
Hausa: A shekarar 2017, kusan mutane miliyan 425 suke fama da ciwon suga (DM) a faxin duniya, kuma ana hasashen qaruwar wannan adadin zuwa miliyan 629 a shekarar 2045.
Northern Sotho: Batho bao ba ka balelwago go dimilione tše 425 ba bile le bothata bja bolwetši bja kelo ya godimo ya swikiri ka mading lefaseng ka bophara ka 2017, gomme se se akanyetšwa go hlatlogela go dimilione tše 629 ka 2045.
Amharic: በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ  በ2017 እ.ኢ.አ፣ በግምት 425 ሚሊዮን  የሚሆን ህዝብ በስኳር በሽታ (ስ.በ) ተጠቅቷል፤ እና ይህም በ2045 እ.ኢ.አ ወደ 629 ሚሊዮን ከፍ ይላል ተብሎ ይገመታል፡፡

English: One common and yet underestimated complication of diabetes mellitus is erectile dysfunction (ED), which is the inability to achieve and maintain an erection sufficient to permit satisfactory sexual intercourse.
Luganda: Ekimu ku buzibu obutafiiriddwako nnyo obuleetebwa sukaali bwe butaba na maanyi ga kisajja (ED), ekiremesa omuntu okuyimuka obulungi ng’ali mu mukwano.
Yoruba: Ìṣoro ìtọ-ṣúga kan tí ó gbajúgbajà tí a kò sì tí ì kàsí ni àìlèṣe-bí-ọkùnrin (ED), tí ó túmọ̀ sí àìlè mára le láti fi ààye gba ìbálòpọ̀ débi ìgbádùn.
Zulu: Omunye umthelela onganakiwe wesifo soshukela ekungavukelwa (ED), okusho ukungakwazi ukuvukelwa kahle nokugcina ukuvukelwa kwakho ukuze ukwazi ukwenza ucansi olwanele futhi olunelisayo.
Hausa: Mutuwar azzakari na xaya daga cikin illolin ciwon suga da ba a lura da su, wanda shi ne rashin qarfin azzakari da zai iya wadatar da jima’i.
Northern Sotho: Bothata botee bjo bo sa tlwaelegilego eupša bjoo bo sa elwego tlhoko ya bolwetši bja kelo ya godimo ya swikiri ka mading ke go palelwa ke go emiša lenaka, e lego go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna le go se tsogelwe nako ye telele go kgontšha motho go tsenela tša thobalano ka tsela ye e kgotsofatšago.
Amharic: አንድ የተለመደ ግን ዝቅተኛ ግምት የሚሰጠው የስኳር በሽታ ውስብስብ ችግር የብልት መቆም ችግር (ብ.መ.ች) ነው፡፡ ይህም አርኪ የሆነን ወሲባዊ ግንኙነት ለመፈጸም በሚያስችል መልኩ ብልትን ማቆም እና እንደቆመም ማቆየት አለመቻል ነው፡፡

English: Erectile dysfunction has been reported in 49% of the diabetic male population in England, 35.8% in Italy, 77.1% in South Africa, and 67.9% in Ghana.
Luganda: Obutaba na maanyi ga kisajja kuzuuliddwa mu basajja abalina obulwadde bwa sukaali abawerera ddala ebitundu 49% mu ggwanga lya Bungereza, ebitundu 35.8% mu Yitale, ebitundu 77.1% mu South Africa n’ebitundu 67.9% mu ggwanga lya Ghana.
Yoruba: Ìròyìn À̀ìlèṣe-bí-ọkùnrin ti gbígbé jáde lára 49% iyé àwọn ọkùnrin tí ó ní ìtọ-ṣúga ní orílè-èdè England, 35.8% ní Italy, 77.1% ní South Africa, àti 67.9% ní Ghana.
Zulu: Ukungavukelwa sekubikwe ebantwini besilisa abangu-49% eNgilandi, 35.8% e-Ithali, 77.1% eNingizimu Afrika, no 67.9% eGana.
Hausa: A samu mutuwar azzakari a kashi 49% cikin maza masu ciwon suga a Ingila, 35.8% a Italiya, 77.1% a Afirka ta Kudu, da 67.9% a Gana.
Northern Sotho: Go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna go begilwe go 49% tša bakgathatema ba banna bao ba nago le bolwetši bja swikiri go la Engelane, 35.8% ka Ithali, 77.1% ka Afrika Borwa, le 67.9% go la Ghana.
Amharic: 49 % በሚሆኑ  የለንደን ነዋሪ የስኳር በሽተኛ ወንዶች 35.8 % በጣሊያን፣77.1 %  በደቡብ አፍሪካ፣እና 67.9 % በጋና፤የብልት መቆም ችግር ተዘግቧል፡፡

English: But other reports from Africa vary greatly, so researchers compared reports to see how prevalent erectile dysfunction is in diabetes mellitus patients, and to determine a possible association with being overweight and with having high blood sugar.
Luganda: Naye obubaka obulala okuva mu Afrika bwawukana nnyo, awo nno abanoonyereza baageraageranya obubaka okulaba engeri obutaba na maanyi ga kisajja gye buli mu balwadde ba sukaali n’okuzuula gye kiyinza okuba nga kyekuusa ku kuba n’obuzito obususse wamu ne sukaali omungi.
Yoruba: Àmọ́, àwọn àbájáde mìíràn ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà yàtọ̀ púpọ̀púpọ̀, nítorí náà, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe àfiwéra àbájáde láti mọ bí àìlèṣe-bí-ọkùnrin ṣe wọ́pọ̀ tó lára aláìsán ìtọ-ṣúgà, àti láti sọ àwọn asomọ́ tí ó ṣeéṣe kí ó so mọ́ ara-àsanjù àti àpọ̀jù ṣúgà nínú ẹ̀jẹ̀.
Zulu: Kodwa eminye imibiko ephuma e-Afrika ihluka kakhulu, ngakho ke abacwaningi baqhathanisa imibiko ukubona ukuthi ukungavukelwa kuvame kangakanani ezigulini zikashukela, nokuthola ukuhlangana kwakho nokukhuluphala nokuba ne-high blood pressure(ihayihayi).
Hausa: Sai dai bayanai daga Afirka sun bambanta sosai, saboda haka masu bincike sun kwatanta bayanan don su gano yanda mutuwar azzakari yake cikin masu ciwon suga, kuma a gano alaqarsa da nauyin jiki da yawan sugar jini.
Northern Sotho: Eupša dipego tše dingwe ka kontinenteng ya Afrika di fapana kudu, ka gona banyakišiši ba bapeditše dipego go bona ka moo go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna go atilego ka gona go balwetši bao ba nago le kelo ya godimo ya swikiri ka mading, le go lemoga kgonagalo ya go ba le kamano le mmele o montši gammogo le kelo ya godimo ya swikiri mmeleng.
Amharic: ነገር ግን ሌሎቹ ከአፍሪካ የመጡት ዘገባዎች እጅግ በጣም ይለያያሉ ፤ስለዚህ ተመራማሪዎቹ   በስኳር በሽታ  ታማሚዎች ዘንድ እንዴት የብልት መቆም ችግር እንደተስፋፋ፣ ከመጠን ካለፈ የሰውነት ክብደት እና ከከፍተኛ የስኳር መጠን ጋር ዝምድና መኖር አለመኖሩን ለመወሰን ዘገባዎቹን ያነጻጽራሉ፡፡

English: The researchers searched through the libraries of PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Scopus, PsycINFO, African Journals Online, and Google Scholar for studies that looked at erectile dysfunction in diabetes mellitus patients.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baanoonya mu tterekero ly’ebiwandiiko erya PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Scopus, PsycINFO, African Journals Online ne ku Google Scholar okufuna okunoonyereza okwakolebwa ku butaba na maanyi ga kisajja mu balwadde ba sukaali.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí wo àwọn yàrá ìkàwé PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Scopus, PsycINFO, African Journals Online àti Google Scholar fún àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí tí ó wo àìlèṣe-bí-ọkùnrin lára aláìsàn tí ó ní ìtọ-ṣúgà.
Zulu: Abacaningi babheke emitapweni yolwazi ye-PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Scopus, PsycINFO, African Journals Online no-Google Scholar bebheka ucwaningo olwalubheka ukungavukelwa ezigulini zashukela.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun binciko cikin laburaren PubMed, Web of Science, Laburaren Cochrane, Scopus, PsycINFO, African Journals Online, da Google Scholar don tsamo binciken da aka yi kan mutuwar azzakari cikin masu ciwon suga.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba nyakile tshedimošo go makgobapuku a PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Scopus, PsycINFO, African Journals Online, le Google Scholar go hwetša dinyakišišo tše di lebeletšego go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna go balwetši bao ba nago le kelo ya godimo ya swikiri ka mading.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በስኳር በሽተኞች ላይ ያለውን የብልት መቆም ችግር በተመለከተ፣ የተሰሩ ጥናቶችን እንደ ፐብሜድ፣ዌብኦፍ ሳንይንስ፣ኮክሬን ላይብረሪ፣ ስኮፐስ፣ሳይክኢንፎ፣ በመስመር ላይ ያሉ አፍሪካዊ መጽሄቶች፣ እና ጉግል ስኮላር ላይ በስፋት ዳሰሳ አድርገዋል፡፡

English: They used various statistical methods to analyse the findings of the 13 studies that had a total of 3,501 participants.
Luganda: Baakozesa obukodyo bw’ebibalo obw’enjawulo okusengejja ebyazuulibwa mu kunoonyereza kwa mirundi 13 okwenyigiramu abeetabi 3,501 omugatte.
Yoruba: Wọ́n lo oríṣiríṣi ìlànà ìtúpalẹ̀ láti ṣe àtúpalẹ̀ àwọn àbọ̀ inú ìwádìí 13 léyìí tí ó ní àpapọ̀ 3,501 akópa.
Zulu: Basebenzise izindlela zezibalo ezahlukene ukucubungula iziphumo zocwaningo oluyi-13 olwalunabantu abayizi-3,501.
Hausa: Sun yi amfani da hanyoyin lissafi masu yawa wajen nazarin sakamon binciken guda 13 da aka yi kan mutane 3,501.
Northern Sotho: Ba šomišitše mekgwa ye e fapafapanego ya tirišo ya dipalopalo go sekaseka dikutollo tša dinyakišišo tše 13 tšeo di bilego le palomoka ya bakgathatema 3,501.
Amharic: በጠቅላላው 3501 ተሳታፊዎች የተሳተፉባቸውን 13 የጥናት ግኝቶችን ለመተንተን የተለያዩ ስታትስቲካዊ ዘዴዎችን  ተጠቅመዋል፡፡

English: They conducted a sensitivity analysis to make sure that not a single study influenced others, which would skew the overall estimation of the prevalence of erectile dysfunction in the participants.
Luganda: Beekaliriza ekivaamu ekireetezi kye kituusa ku kikosebwa okukakasa nti tewaaliwo kunoonyereza kwonna kwakosa kunoonyereza kulala, ekyandiyinzizza okufuula okuteebereza kw’obutaba na maanyi ga kisajja mu beetabi okuba nga kwekubidde ku ludda lumu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fi ojú sílẹ̀ ṣe àtúpalẹ̀ láti rí i pé ọ̀kankan àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí náà kò nípà lórí òmìíràn, léyìí tí ó lè dábùú àbájáde gbogbogbò okùnfà ìwọ́pọ̀ àìlèṣe-bí-ọkùnrin lára àwọn akópa.
Zulu: Babenokucophelela kakhulu ukuze beqinisekise ukuthi ucwaningo nocwaningo alubi namthelela kolunye, okungenza kungabi nokugagula kahle ngokuvama kokungavukelwa kwababehlolwa.
Hausa: Sun yi awon daidaito tsakanin aiyukan don tabbatar da cewa babu aiki guda xaya da ya rinjayi saura, wanda hakan zai iya kawar da lissafin yawaitar mutuwar azzakari cikin mutanen da aka yi bincike a kansu.
Northern Sotho: Ba dirile tshekatsheko ya go kwa maikutlo go kgonthišiša gore ga go dinyakišišo tšeo di hueditšego tše dingwe, tšeo di tla fetošago kakanyo ka kakaretšo ya go ata ga go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna go bakgathatema.
Amharic: ተስፋፍቶ ያለው የብልት መቆም ችግር አጠቃላይ ግምት አለማዛባቱን ለማረጋገጥ እና አንድም ጥናት በሌሎቹ ላይ ተጽእኖ እንዳያመጣ፣ የሴንሲቲቪቲ ትንተና አካሂደዋል፡፡

English: The study found that erectile dysfunction was prevalent in 71.45% of male diabetes mellitus patients in Africa.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kwazuula nti obutaba na maanyi ga kisajja kwali mu balwadde ba sukaali abasajja abawerera ddala 71.45% mu Afrika.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí náà ṣàkíyèsí pé àìlèṣe-bí-ọkùnrin wọ́pọ̀ lára 71.45% àwọn ọkùnrin aláìsàn ìtọ-ṣúgà ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi ukungavukelwa kuvame kubantu besilisa abanesifo sashukela abangu 71.45% e-Afrika.
Hausa: Binciken ya gano akwai mutuwar azzakari cikin kashi 71.45% na maza masu ciwon suga a Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di utollotše gore go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna go be go atile go 71.45% tša balwetši ba banna bao ba nago le kelo ya godimo ya swikiri ka mading ka Afrika.
Amharic: ጥናቱ በአፍሪካ በ71.45 % የስኳር በሽተኛ  ወንዶች ላይ የብልት መቆም ችግር እንደተስፋፋ ደርሶበታል፡፡

English: They found that diabetic patients who had a body mass index that indicates obesity were 1.26 times more likely to develop erectile dysfunction.
Luganda: Baazuula nti abalwadde ba sukaali abaalina obunene obwoleka omugejjo baalina 1.26 okusinga ku balala okubulwa amaanyi g’ekisajja.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sàwárí pé àwọn aláìsàn ìtọ̀-ṣúgà tí ó ní ìwọn òòrìn tòhun gíga tìbútòro tí ó fi ara àsanjù hàn ṣeéṣe; kí ó jẹ àìlèṣe-bí-ọkùnrin yọ ní pẹ̀lú ìdá 1.26 ìgbà.
Zulu: Bathola ukuthi iziguli ezikhuluphele ngokweqile zisemathubeni angu 1.26 ngaphezu kwezinye, ukuthi zihlushwe ukungavukelwa.
Hausa: Sun gano cewar masu ciwon suga da suke da nauyin jiki wanda ya wuce mizani sun fi kamuwa da mutuwar azzakari da xigo 1.26.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gore balwetši bao ba nago le swikiri bao ba bego ba na le mmele o montši wo o laetšago go nona ba be ba na le kgonagalo ya makga a 1.26 go feta a go itemogela go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna.
Amharic: አጠቃላይ የሰውነት ትልቅነታቸው ወደ ግዙፍነት የሚያዘነብል  የስኳር በሽተኞች1.26 ግዜ የበለጠ የብልት መቆም ችግር ሊያዳብሩ እንደሚችሉ ደርሰውበታል፡፡

English: They also found that diabetic patients whose blood sugar control was good, as indicated by glycated hemoglobin of 7%, a measure of long term blood sugar control, were 7% less likely to develop erectile dysfunction.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu era baazuula nti abalwadde ba sukaali ng’ekipimo kya sukaali ali mu mubiri gyabwe kirungi nga bwe kyolekebwa n’ebitundu 7% mu kupima puloteyini ya sukaali ekiraga okufuga sukaali mu mubiri mu bbanga eggwanvu baalina emikisa gya bitundu 7% obutabulwa maanyi ga kisajja.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún ṣàwárí pé àwọn aláìsàn ìtọ̀-ṣúga tí ìmójútó súgà inú ẹ̀jẹ̀ wọn dàra, gẹ̣́gẹ́ bí imogilobíìnì ajẹmọ́-ṣúgà 7%, ìwọ̀n àmójútó súgà ọjọ́ pípẹ́, ṣeéṣe pẹ̀lú 7% ó dín kí ó bí àìlèṣe-bí-ọkùnrin.
Zulu: Bathole nokuthi iziguli eziphethwe ushukela ezinamazinga kashukela oqashwe kahle, okubonakala ngo-7% we-glycaed hemoglobin, okukalwa ngakho ukuthi ushukela wakho uqashwe kahle, zisemathubeni ehle ngo-7% okuhlushwa ukungavukelwa.
Hausa: Sun kuma gano cewar masu ciwon suga waxanda suke da daidaiton sugar jini, wanda ake ganowa in sinadarin protin mai tafiyar da numfashi cikin jini ya tsaya a kashi 7%, na da qarancin samun mutuwar azzakari da kashi 7%.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gape gore balwetši bao ba nago le swikiri bao taolo ya swikiri ya bona mading e bego e le gabotse, bjalo ka ge go laeditšwe ke kelo ya klukhose ka mading ya 7%, kelo ya taolo ya swiking mading ya nako ye telele, go be go na le kgonagalo ya 7% ya go itemogela go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም  በ7% ግላይኬትድ ሄሞግሎቢን ጥቆማ መሰረት፣ የደማቸው የስኳር ቁጥጥር ጥሩ የሆነ እና የረዥም ጊዜ የደም ስኳር ቁጥጥር ያላቸው የስኳር በሽተኞች፣ የብልት መቆም ችግር የማዳበራቸው እድል 7%  ያህል ሊቀንስ እንደሚችል ደርሰውበታል፡፡

English: The study has several limitations that should be considered in future research.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kulimu obunafu obw’enjawulo obusaanye okufiibwako mu kunoonyereza okunaakolebwa mu biseera ebijja.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí náà ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ akùdé tí ó yẹ ní mímójú tó nínú àwọn ìwádìí ọjọ́ iwájú.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lunezingqinamba ezimbalwa okumele zicatshangwe ocwaningweni oluzayo.
Hausa: Binciken na da illoli waxanda ya kamata a duba cikin bincike nan gaba.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo di na le ditšhitišo tše mmalwa tšeo di swanetšego go elwa tlhoko go dinyakišišo tša ka moso.
Amharic: ጥናቱ ፣በመጪዎቹ ምርምሮች ከግምት ውስጥ ሊገቡ የሚገባቸው አያሌ ገደቦች አሉበት፡፡

English: First, it is difficult to determine if the results from various countries are representative of the entire continent because no data were found for all of Africa.
Luganda: Okusooka, kizibu okukakasa oba ng’ebizuuliddwa mu mawanga ag’enjawulo bikiikirira olukalu lwonna kubanga tewaliiwo bubaka bwonna bwafunibwa nga buzingiramu Afrika yonna.
Yoruba: Àkọ́kọ́, ó ṣòro láti sọ pé bóyá àwọn èsì láti àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè gbogbo ń ṣojú fún gbogbo ilẹ̀ ni, ìdí ni pé a kò ṣàwárí dátà kankan fún gbogbò ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Okukuqala, kunzima ukubona ukuthi imiphumela evela emazwen ahlukene ikhuluma ngezwekazi lonke ngoba ayitholakalanga imininingwane ebala i-Afrika yonke.
Hausa: Na farko, ya na da wuya a gano ko sakamakon binciken da aka yi a mabambanta qasashe na iya wakiltar nahiyar baki xaya, domin babu bayanai da aka samu kan nahiyar Afirka baki xaya.
Northern Sotho: Sa pele, go boima go laetša ge e ba dipoelo go tšwa ka dinageng tša go fapafapana di emetše kontinente ka bophara ka lebaka la gore ga go datha ye e hweditšwego go Afrika ka bophara.
Amharic: በመጀመሪያ፣በአፍሪካ ምንም ውሂብ/ዳታ ባለመገኘቱ ከተለያዩ ሃገራት የተገኙት ውጤቶች መላውን አህጉር ይወክላሉ ብሎ ለመወሰን አስቸጋሪ ነው፡፡

English: Second, the study only considered English articles, which means the study could be missing important data published in other languages.
Luganda: Ekyokubiri, okunoonyereza kwafa ku biwandiiko ebyawandiikibwa mu Lungereza byokka, ekitegeeza nti kuyinza okuba nga tekuliimu bubaka obw’omuwendo obwafulumizibwa mu nnimi endala.
Yoruba: Ìkejì, àkọsílẹ̀ lédè Gẹ̀ẹ́sì nìkan ni iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí gbé yẹ̀wò léyìí tí ó jẹ́ pé iṣẹ́ ìwádìí náà le máa pàdánù àwọn dátà tí a fi èdè mìíràn gbé jáde.
Zulu: Okwesibili, ucwaningo lubheke imibhalo ebhalwe ngesingisi, okusho ukuthi ucwaningo lungashoda ngemininingwane ebalulekile etholakala kwezinye izilimi.
Hausa: Na biyu, binciken ya dogare ne kan muqalun da aka yi cikin harshen Ingilishi kaxai, wanda hankan na nufin binciken ka iya barin bayanai masu amfani sosai da aka wallafa cikin wasu harsuna.
Northern Sotho: Sa bobedi, dinyakišišo di lebeletše fela dingwalwa tše di ngwadilwego ka Seisimane, se se šupa gore dinyakišišo di ka ba di hloka datha ye bohlokwa ye e gatišitšwego ka dipolelo tše dingwe.
Amharic: ሁለተኛ፣ ጥናቱ ከግምት ውስጥ ያስገባው  የእንጊሊዘኛ ጽሁፎችን ብቻ ነው፤ ይህ ማለት ደግሞ ጥናቱ በሌሎች ቋንቋዎች የታተሙ ጠቃሚ ዳታዎች/ውሂቦች ሊያመልጡት ይችላሉ፡፡

English: These results show that the prevalence of erectile dysfunction in diabetes patients in Africa remains high.
Luganda: Bino ebizuuliddwa biraga nti obutaba na maanyi ga kisajja mu balwadde ba sukaali mu Afrika bukyali waggulu.
Yoruba: Èsì wọ̀nyìí ṣe àfihàn bí ìwọ́pọ̀ àìlèṣe-bí-ọkùnrin ní ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà ṣe gbé sókè síbẹ̀.
Zulu: Lemiphumela ikhombisa ukuthi amazinga okwanda kokungavukelwa ezigulini ezinoshukela e-Afrika ahleli phezulu.
Hausa: Wannan sakamon ya nuna cewar a akwai yawaitar mutuwar azzakari cikin masu ciwon suga a Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tše di bontšha gore go ata ga go se tsogelwe ga setho sa bonna go balwetši bao ba nago le twetšiswikiri ka Afrika go phela go le godimo.
Amharic: እነዚህ ውጤቶች በአፍሪካ ባሉ የስኳር በሽተኞች ላይ የሚከሰተው የብልት መቆም ችግር እንደተስፋፋ እንደሚቀጥል ያሳያሉ፡፡

English: The researchers recommend that countries should develop situation-based interventions specific to each country.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bawa endowooza nti buli ggwanga lisaanye liteekewo ebirina okukolebwa okulwanyisa ekizibu ekyo okusinziira ku mbeera eriwo.
Yoruba: Àwọn Aṣèwádìí dá a lábàá pé kí àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè ó sẹ̀dá ọ̀nà-àbáyọ̀ tó bàsẹ̀lẹ̀ wí fún orílẹ̀-èdè kọ̀ọ̀kan.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bancoma ukuthi amazwe kumele angenelele isimo nesimo kuwo wonke amazwe.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ba da shawarar xaukan matakai daidai da kevavvun yanayin ko wane qasa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišinya gore dinaga di swanetše go tla ka maitekelo a go tsena seemo ka bogare ao a sepelelanago le naga ye nngwe le ye nngwe.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ለየእያንዳንዱ ሃገር ልዩ የሆኑ እና ሁኔታ-ተኮር የሆኑ ጣልቃገብ ስራዎችን እንዲያዳብሩ ይመክራሉ፡፡
